outcome_evidence: The oven is closed at frame 0 in image and left_ego_image. The robot gradually approaches and aligns with the door/handle area, visible at frames 100, 200 and 280 in image and wrist_image. At frames 300–309, the gripper is near the handle, but no clear door opening is visible in image, left_ego_image or wrist_image. Completion is therefore unconfirmed in the observed episode, rather than a visibly completed failed grasp or pull; the recording ends during the approach/acquisition sequence.
